import { getProductHot } from '@/api/store.js';
import { toLogin } from '@/libs/login.js';
import { mapGetters } from 'vuex';
import { HTTP_REQUEST_URL } from '@/config/app';
import recommend from '@/components/recommend';
import NavBar from '@/components/NavBar';
export default {
    components: {
        recommend,
        NavBar
    },
    data() {
        return {
            imgHost: HTTP_REQUEST_URL,
            reach_count: 0,
            VipList: [],
            // indicatorDots: false,
            // circular: true,
            // autoplay: false,
            // interval: 3000,
            // duration: 500,
            currentIndex: 0,
            growthValue: true,
            task: [], //任务列表
            illustrate: '', //任务说明
            level_id: 0, //任务id,
            hostProduct: [],
            grade: 0,
            isAuto: false, //没有授权的不会自动授权
            isShowAuth: false, //是否隐藏授权
            hotScroll: false,
            hotPage: 1,
            hotLimit: 10,
            level_title: '',
            level_discount: '',
            levelInfo: {},
            task_list: [
                {
                    real_name: '积分数',
                    number: 0
                },
                {
                    real_name: '消费金额',
                    number: 0
                },
                {
                    real_name: '优惠券',
                    number: 0
                }
            ],
            userInfo: {},
            taskInfo: {},
            is_open_member: false, //判断是否开启付费会员
            // #ifdef MP
            iconColor: '#FFFFFF',
            isScrolling: false,
            // #endif
            signInStatus: 0 //签到是否开启
        };
    },
    computed: {
        ...mapGetters(['isLogin'])
    },
    watch: {
        VipList: function () {
            let that = this;
            if (that.VipList.length > 0) {
                that.VipList.forEach(function (item, index) {
                    if (item.is_clear === false) {
                        // that.swiper.slideTo(index);
                        that.activeIndex = index;
                        that.grade = item.grade;
                    }
                });
            }
        },
        isLogin: {
            handler: function (newV, oldV) {
                if (newV) {
                    // #ifdef H5 || APP-PLUS
                    this.setLeveLComplete();
                    // #endif
                }
            },
            deep: true
        }
    },
    onLoad() {
        this.get_host_product();
        if (this.isLogin) {
            this.setLeveLComplete();
            this.getlevelInfo();
            this.getUserInfo();
            this.signStatus();
        } else {
            toLogin();
        }
        let that = this;
        setTimeout(function () {
            that.loading = true;
        }, 500);
    },
    onShow() {
        uni.removeStorageSync('form_type_cart');
    },
    onPageScroll(e) {
        uni.$emit('scroll');
        // #ifdef MP
        if (e.scrollTop > 50) {
            this.iconColor = '#333333';
            this.isScrolling = true;
        } else if (e.scrollTop < 50) {
            this.iconColor = '#FFFFFF';
            this.isScrolling = false;
        }
        // #endif
    },
    methods: {
        signStatus() {
            getSignConfig()
                .then((res) => {
                    this.signInStatus = res.data.signStatus;
                })
                .catch((err) => {
                    this.$util.Tips({
                        title: err
                    });
                });
        },
        gradeStyle(item) {
            return {
                'background-image': `url("${item.icon}")`,
                color: item.color
            };
        },
        progressValue(item, index) {
            let width = 100;
            let num = item.exp_num - parseFloat(item.lack_exp_num);
            width = (num / item.exp_num) * 100;
            return {
                width: `${width}%`,
                'background-color': item.color
            };
        },
        getUserInfo: function () {
            getUserInfo().then((res) => {
                this.is_open_member = res.data.is_open_member;
                this.task_list = [
                    {
                        real_name: '积分数',
                        number: res.data.integral
                    },
                    {
                        real_name: '消费金额',
                        number: res.data.orderStatusSum
                    },
                    {
                        real_name: '优惠券',
                        number: res.data.couponCount
                    }
                ];
            });
        },
        getlevelInfo: function () {
            getlevelInfo().then((res) => {
                const { level_info, level_list, task, user } = res.data;
                this.levelInfo = level_info;
                this.VipList = level_list;
                this.userInfo = user;
                this.taskInfo = task;
                this.levelInfo.exp = parseFloat(this.levelInfo.exp);
                this.levelInfo.rate = Math.floor((this.levelInfo.exp / this.levelInfo.exp_num) * 100);
                if (this.levelInfo.rate > 100) {
                    this.levelInfo.rate = 100;
                }
                const index = level_list.findIndex(({ grade }) => grade === level_info.grade);
                if (index !== -1) {
                    this.currentIndex = index;
                }
            });
        },
        onLoadFun() {
            this.setLeveLComplete();
            this.getlevelInfo();
            this.getUserInfo();
            this.isShowAuth = false;
        },
        // 授权关闭
        authColse: function (e) {
            this.isShowAuth = e;
        },
        /**
         * 获取我的推荐
         */
        get_host_product: function () {
            let that = this;
            if (that.hotScroll) return;
            getProductHot(that.hotPage, that.hotLimit).then((res) => {
                that.hotPage++;
                that.hotScroll = res.data.length < that.hotLimit;
                that.hostProduct = that.hostProduct.concat(res.data);
            });
        },
        /**
         * 会员切换
         *
         */
        swiperChange(e) {
            let index = e.detail.current;
            this.currentIndex = index;
            this.level_id = this.VipList[index].id || 0;
            this.level_title = this.VipList[index].name || '';
            this.level_discount = this.VipList[index].discount || '';
            // this.grade = this.VipList[index].grade
            // this.getTask();
        },
        /**
         * 关闭说明
         */
        growthValueClose: function () {
            this.growthValue = true;
        },
        /**
         * 打开说明
         */
        opHelp: function (index) {
            this.growthValue = false;
            this.illustrate = this.task[index].illustrate;
        },
        /**
         * 设置会员
         */
        setLeveLComplete: function () {
            let that = this;
            userLevelDetection().then((res) => {
                // that.getVipList();
            });
        },
        /**
         * 获取会员等级
         *
         */
        getVipList: function () {
            let that = this;
            userLevelGrade().then((res) => {
                that.$set(that, 'VipList', res.data.list);
                that.task = res.data.task.task;
                that.reach_count = res.data.task.reach_count;
                that.level_id = res.data.list.length && res.data.list[0] ? res.data.list[0].id : 0;
                that.level_title = res.data.list.length && res.data.list[0] ? res.data.list[0].name : '';
                that.level_discount = res.data.list.length && res.data.list[0] ? res.data.list[0].discount : '';
                // let arr = [];
                // res.data.list.forEach(function(item, index) {
                // 	if (item.is_clear == false) {
                // 		arr.push(item.grade);
                // 	}
                // })
                // that.grade = arr[0] || 0;
                // that.grade = res.data.list[0].grade
            });
        },
        /**
         * 获取任务要求
         */
        getTask: function () {
            let that = this;
            userLevelTask(that.level_id).then((res) => {
                that.task = res.data.task;
                that.reach_count = res.data.reach_count;
            });
        }
    },
    onReachBottom() {
        this.get_host_product();
    }
};
</script>

name: Migration gates (Linux)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: workers-runtime-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Preserve the existing required-check name and fail closed on either dependency.
  worker-static:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route gates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [worker-unit, worker-catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require both unchanged gate groups to succeed
        env:
          UNIT_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-unit.result }}
          CATALOG_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-catalog.result }}
        run: |
          test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "success"
          test "$CATALOG_RESULT" = "success"

  worker-unit:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route execution (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Run 39218895760 still recorded passing native cases at the 90-minute
    # job limit (9,197 case passes, no reported assertion failures). Preserve
    # both shards, per-test deadlines and exact zero-skip coverage checks.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:prod

      # The unit suite bundles real Admin/Supplier auth and Axios code. Frontend
      # build jobs have separate filesystems; both unit shards need each lockfile.
      - name: Install locked Admin dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/admin-ts

      - name: Install locked Supplier dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/supplier-ts

      - name: Install locked Kefu dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/kefu-ts

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for customer SFC unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/uniapp-ts

      - name: Run both TypeScript configurations
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Begin isolated native child diagnostic capture
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts --begin

      - name: Run Worker unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:unit -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=unit-shard-results.json 2>&1 | tee unit-shard.log

      - name: Audit native child diagnostics including incomplete failed runs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts

      - name: Preserve unit shard diagnostics even on failure
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: unit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            workers-ts/unit-shard-results.json
            workers-ts/unit-shard.log
            workers-ts/.cache/native-child-diagnostics/published-*/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify exact executed unit shard coverage
        run: node scripts/audit-unit-shards.mjs ${{ matrix.shard }} unit-shard-results.json

      - name: Audit production observability contract
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:observability

      - name: Audit legacy-to-PostgreSQL schema drift
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/mysql-to-postgres.ts schema-audit --json |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({source:r.coverage.sourceTableCount,target:r.coverage.targetTableCount,shared:r.coverage.sharedTableCount,sourceGaps:r.coverage.sourceColumnGapTableCount,externalOnly:r.definitionDrift.externalOnlyTables.length,workerOnly:r.definitionDrift.workerOnlyTables.length,columnDrift:r.definitionDrift.columnDrift.length}));})'

      - name: Audit legacy-to-Worker route parity
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/route-parity-audit.ts |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({authority:r.phpRoot,...r.totals}));})'

  worker-catalog:
    name: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 migration catalog execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Execute isolated PostgreSQL 16 ORM and migration catalog audit
        run: npm run audit:orm

      - name: Verify NOT VALID generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:not-valid

      - name: Verify sequence generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:sequences

      - name: Measure FK statistics candidates on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:work-fk:statistics-scale

      - name: Verify formal shipping indexes and measure isolated read/write costs
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: npm run audit:shipping-lifecycle-capacity

      - name: Preserve complete synthetic shipping plans
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: shipping-index-capacity-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cinashop-shipping-capacity-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  runtime:
    name: workerd runtime tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm run audit:prod

      - name: Run Workers runtime tests
        run: npm run test:runtime

  frontends:
    name: ${{ matrix.name }} build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Admin
            directory: admin-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: PC
            directory: pc-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Supplier
            directory: supplier-ts
            command: npm run build
          - name: Kefu
            directory: kefu-ts
            command: npm test && npm run build
          - name: UniApp
            directory: uniapp-ts
            command: npm run typecheck && npm run test:toolchain && npm run test:admzip && npm run test:express-qs && npm run test:jest-jsdom-once && npm run test:d3-advisories && npm run build:h5 && npm run build:mp-weixin && npm run build:app && npm run test:build-artifacts && npm run test:automator-qr && npm run test:runtime-i18n
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: view/${{ matrix.directory }}/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}
        run: npm ci

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for actual carousel projection
        if: matrix.directory == 'admin-ts'
        working-directory: view/uniapp-ts
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run type, test and build contract
        working-directory: view/${{ matrix.directory }}

name: Migration gates (Linux)

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - "workers-ts/**"
      - "view/common/**"
      - "view/shared/**"
      - "view/admin-ts/**"
      - "view/pc-ts/**"
      - "view/supplier-ts/**"
      - "view/kefu-ts/**"
      - "view/uniapp-ts/**"
      - ".gitleaks.toml"
      - ".gitattributes"
      - ".github/workflows/workers-runtime-linux.yml"

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: workers-runtime-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  # Preserve the existing required-check name and fail closed on either dependency.
  worker-static:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route gates
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs: [worker-unit, worker-catalog]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 2
    steps:
      - name: Require both unchanged gate groups to succeed
        env:
          UNIT_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-unit.result }}
          CATALOG_RESULT: ${{ needs.worker-catalog.result }}
        run: |
          test "$UNIT_RESULT" = "success"
          test "$CATALOG_RESULT" = "success"

  worker-unit:
    name: Worker type, unit, schema and route execution (shard ${{ matrix.shard }}/2)
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        shard: [1, 2]
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    # Run 39218895760 still recorded passing native cases at the 90-minute
    # job limit (9,197 case passes, no reported assertion failures). Preserve
    # both shards, per-test deadlines and exact zero-skip coverage checks.
    timeout-minutes: 120
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:prod

      # The unit suite bundles real Admin/Supplier auth and Axios code. Frontend
      # build jobs have separate filesystems; both unit shards need each lockfile.
      - name: Install locked Admin dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/admin-ts

      - name: Install locked Supplier dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/supplier-ts

      - name: Install locked Kefu dependencies for cross-package unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/kefu-ts

      - name: Install locked Uni dependencies for customer SFC unit tests
        run: npm ci --prefix ../view/uniapp-ts

      - name: Run both TypeScript configurations
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run typecheck

      - name: Begin isolated native child diagnostic capture
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts --begin

      - name: Run Worker unit tests
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -o pipefail
          npm run test:unit -- --shard=${{ matrix.shard }}/2 --reporter=verbose --reporter=json --outputFile.json=unit-shard-results.json 2>&1 | tee unit-shard.log

      - name: Audit native child diagnostics including incomplete failed runs
        if: ${{ always() }}
        run: node node_modules/tsx/dist/cli.mjs scripts/audit-native-child-diagnostics.ts

      - name: Preserve unit shard diagnostics even on failure
        if: ${{ always() }}
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: unit-shard-${{ matrix.shard }}-${{ github.sha }}
          include-hidden-files: true
          path: |
            workers-ts/unit-shard-results.json
            workers-ts/unit-shard.log
            workers-ts/.cache/native-child-diagnostics/published-*/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

      - name: Verify exact executed unit shard coverage
        run: node scripts/audit-unit-shards.mjs ${{ matrix.shard }} unit-shard-results.json

      - name: Audit production observability contract
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: npm run audit:observability

      - name: Audit legacy-to-PostgreSQL schema drift
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/mysql-to-postgres.ts schema-audit --json |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({source:r.coverage.sourceTableCount,target:r.coverage.targetTableCount,shared:r.coverage.sharedTableCount,sourceGaps:r.coverage.sourceColumnGapTableCount,externalOnly:r.definitionDrift.externalOnlyTables.length,workerOnly:r.definitionDrift.workerOnlyTables.length,columnDrift:r.definitionDrift.columnDrift.length}));})'

      - name: Audit legacy-to-Worker route parity
        if: matrix.shard == 1
        run: |
          npx --no-install tsx scripts/route-parity-audit.ts |
            node -e 'let s="";process.stdin.on("data",d=>s+=d).on("end",()=>{const r=JSON.parse(s);console.log(JSON.stringify({authority:r.phpRoot,...r.totals}));})'

  worker-catalog:
    name: Isolated PostgreSQL 16 migration catalog execution
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    services:
      postgres:
        image: postgres:16.14-alpine
        env:
          POSTGRES_USER: finance_test
          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: finance_test
          POSTGRES_DB: cinashop_finance_test
        ports:
          - 5432:5432
        options: >-
          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U finance_test -d cinashop_finance_test"
          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
    env:
      TEST_FINANCE_POSTGRES_URL: postgresql://finance_test:finance_test@127.0.0.1:5432/cinashop_finance_test
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm
          cache-dependency-path: workers-ts/package-lock.json

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Execute isolated PostgreSQL 16 ORM and migration catalog audit
        run: npm run audit:orm

      - name: Verify NOT VALID generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:not-valid

      - name: Verify sequence generator semantics on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:orm:sequences

      - name: Measure FK statistics candidates on isolated PostgreSQL 16
        run: npm run audit:work-fk:statistics-scale

      - name: Verify formal shipping indexes and measure isolated read/write costs
        env:
          TMPDIR: ${{ runner.temp }}
        run: npm run audit:shipping-lifecycle-capacity

      - name: Preserve complete synthetic shipping plans
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4
        with:
          name: shipping-index-capacity-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/cinashop-shipping-capacity-*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  runtime:
    name: workerd runtime tests
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 15
    defaults:
      run:
        working-directory: workers-ts
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@de0fac2e4500dabe0009e67214ff5f5447ce83dd # v6.0.2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@48b55a011bda9f5d6aeb4c2d9c7362e8dae4041e # v6.4.0
        with:
          node-version: "24.14.1"
          cache: npm

      - name: Verify pinned Node and npm
        run: |
          test "$(node --version)" = "v24.14.1"
          test "$(npm --version)" = "11.11.0"

      - name: Install locked dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Audit production dependencies
        run: npm run audit:prod

      - name: Run Workers runtime tests
        run: npm run test:runtime

    name: ${{ matrix.name }} build
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:

    steps:
